description: This source file defines a final class 'CronJobsStore' that manages the state and operations related to cron jobs in a macOS application. It includes properties and methods for listing, running, removing, enabling/disabling, and handling events for cron jobs, utilizing asynchronous tasks and logging. The class appears to follow the singleton pattern and interacts with external gateway connection methods.

classes.name: CronJobsStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages cron job state, operations, and event handling for the application.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes event and polling tasks to refresh cron jobs periodically, unless running in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels all running background tasks related to cron job monitoring.

methods.name: refreshJobs
methods.description: Loads the current list of cron jobs and updates scheduler status info from the gateway.

methods.name: refreshRuns
methods.description: Loads recent run entries for a specific cron job.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Triggers execution of a specific cron job, with an option to force.

methods.name: removeJob
methods.description: Removes a specified cron job and refreshes the job list; clears selection if the job was selected.

methods.name: setJobEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific cron job.

methods.name: upsertJob
methods.description: Updates an existing or adds a new cron job with specified payload.

methods.name: handle(push:)
methods.description: Handles incoming push events, updating job states or scheduling refreshes accordingly.

methods.name: handle(cronEvent:)
methods.description: Processes specific cron events, possibly triggering refreshes.

methods.name: scheduleRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a deferred refresh of cron jobs after a specified delay.

methods.name: scheduleRunsRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a deferred refresh of cron job runs after a delay.
